acceptanceCriteria: First retention writes .corvint/.gitignore (or equivalent) so git status --porcelain is empty after a retained run, covered by a test with a real git repo
test-validity --discover still finds the retained documents
Shared retention helper used by the JS and Go/Ruby providers; spec requirement added
body: GitHub #1132. corvint-js-test-provider e2e --retain writes <worktree>/.corvint/test-evidence/*.json with nothing ignoring it, so git status --porcelain shows ?? .corvint/ and later clean-worktree checks (including the provider's own dirty digest) treat the worktree as dirty. Expected: retention keeps the worktree clean, e.g. writes .corvint/.gitignore containing * on first retention (test-validity --discover still finds the documents), or supports a retention root outside the worktree. The Ruby provider (V1-1797) must use the same helper.
title: GH #1132: --retain leaves .corvint/test-evidence untracked in git status, dirtying later runs
